comments.value: After the breaking of sub animator parameter drivers that occurred recently, this feature jumps from a nice opportunity for support, to a necessary function of puppeteering avatars. The Menu is helpful, but it's far more easy to physically move and touch things on your avatar to convey the different animations. We were able to work around not having a touch component with stop-action particle drivers, but now that that's gone, a replacement is needed. Honestly, multiple features that allow an accessible way to drive parameters outside of the action menu would be lovely, but this ranks around the most important one in my opinion.

Since I made good use of sub animator parameter drivers to make interesting (and useful) animations - notably my dodging game and an in-game keyboard. These animations primarily used movement to activate a parameter driver.
It would be great if there was a replacement for this. I need a way to detect movements (or button presses on an external menu) to change a parameter.
